system.description:
You manipulate kinetic energy around a target to move it.

Choose a non-creature object within 30 spaces of Size 1 or smaller. You can move that object 5 spaces in any direction. The target object cannot be moved more than 30 spaces away from you.

This spell can be used to perform simple interactions with the object, such as pulling a lever, or opening a door.

The object moves too slowly to be used effectively for an attack, though it may be dropped.

Your control over the object lasts until the start of your next turn, after which it returns to normal.

While this spell is active, you can use an Action to manipulate the object again, selecting the same target or a new target as you wish. If you select a new target, you relinquish control over the previous target.

Each extra success extends the duration of your control by +1 rounds.

Alternatively, you may increase the maximum Size of the object you can affect by +1 per 2 extra successes.
